items.title: The EPA is planning to scrap public review rules for data center pollution

brief.whatHappened: "The EPA is planning to scrap public review rules for data center pollution" reached the Hacker News front page with 509 points and 403 comments.
brief.whyItMatters: The energy and water cost of AI is part of the engineering trade-off. Numbers from real deployments let you argue for a smaller model or a cached answer.

keyConcepts.explanation: The electricity one model request consumes. It depends on model size, hardware and batching, and published figures often leave out training.
Grams of CO2 emitted per kilowatt hour. It changes by region and by hour, so where and when a job runs matters.

brief.whatHappened: OpenAI News published "Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users". Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.
brief.whyItMatters: Failures at scale follow a small number of patterns. Each real incident or analysis is a worked example of a pattern you will meet in your own systems.

keyConcepts.explanation: Getting several machines to agree on one value or one order of events even when some of them fail or messages are lost.
The strongest single-object consistency model. Every operation appears to happen at one instant between its start and its end.

items.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
items.excerpt: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.

brief.whatHappened: The Cloudflare Blog published "Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB". Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.
